example_prompts: Stress-test my idea: a $9 a month meal-kit subscription for college students, delivered to dorms. I'm a solo founder with $5,000 to start.
Brainstorm ways to cut onboarding drop-off in our fitness app without building new features. About half of new users quit in the first week.
Play devil's advocate: we sell design templates and want to add a marketplace where other creators sell theirs. What could go wrong?
Give me six different ways to help new hires at a remote company feel less lost in their first two weeks, and tell me which one you would try first.
